snippet.title: Early Access Gameplay Trailer Varthos – Heir to the Throne
snippet.description:
A little about the game:
“ 'Varthos – Heir to the Throne' is an action role-playing game which borrows from the hack’n’slay and rogue-lite genres with a bit of extraction gameplay added to the mixture.  It's played in a top-down perspective and you control your character directly: no point and click but WASD and mouse. It is being developed for cooperative multiplayer mode, but will also be playable in single player – albeit with an increased difficulty level. Other features include 'no fixed classes', 'randomised loot', 'randomised skills', 'randomised dungeons', 'permadeath', 'meta progression' and more!"
